{{Quote|Nice shooting, Nine. Why ion? You could have killed the Headhunters in one shot the way you fly, but you used ion and made it tougher. Was this a game for you?''"<br />"''No, sir. The Headhunter pilots were just doing their jobs. If we kill them, we're just butchers and killers and any bodyguards in the future know they should go after us full out because we're going to vape them.|[[Jacob Nive]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="IJ" />}}
The '''Attack on the ''Galaxy Chance''''' was a raid of the [[Khuiumin Survivors]] to capture former [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[Zlece Oonaar]].
